Question ID: SPEECH_U03_L08_GuidedPractice_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.COM.01

Which choice best synthesizes Unit 3 persuasive communication?

answer.text: A. Use a louder voice so the audience agrees

feedback.text: This confuses delivery volume with persuasive planning. A strong speech still needs a clear claim, evidence, reasoning, and audience awareness.

answer.text: B. Ignore the opposing view and repeat the claim

feedback.text: This avoids comparison and weakens credibility. Persuasive communication should address opposing views respectfully and explain reasoning.

answer.text: C. Combine claim, evidence, reasoning, audience awareness, and rebuttal into one plan

feedback.text: Correct. This answer directly supports the lesson skill by using the standard to make communication clearer, better supported, and more audience aware.

answer.text: D. Make a personal attack against the opposing speaker

feedback.text: Personal attacks weaken credibility. Persuasive speakers should respond to ideas with evidence and respectful reasoning.

feedback.text: Correct. This answer directly supports the lesson skill by using the standard to make communication clearer, better supported, and more audience aware.

answer.text: C. Choose details because they sound interesting

answer.text: D. Make a personal attack against the opposing speaker

feedback.text: Personal attacks weaken credibility. Persuasive speakers should respond to ideas with evidence and respectful reasoning.
